A1.justification: Both PDFs contain the same research work, with all 29 pages and Appendices A–F available. Text extraction and rendered-page comparison establish that the scientific content, including figures, tables and equations, is complete and comparable.

before.justification: v2 reports original language-modeling, generation-quality and arithmetic-reasoning experiments in Section 6, with additional experiments and analyses in Appendix D.

after.justification: v3 retains the original empirical results in Section 6 and Appendix D, including evaluations of LDDMs and their baselines.

M1.justification: The deterministic latent pathway, self-conditioning procedure, model variants and Appendix E algorithms are unchanged.

E1.justification: Both versions use the same LM1B/OWT training data, zero-shot corpora, arithmetic-reasoning tasks and Appendix D downstream benchmarks. No dataset or test scenario is added or removed.

E2.justification: Corresponding experiments retain the same SEDD, MDLM, UDLM, autoregressive and MGDM comparators, together with the same appendix comparison variants.

E3.justification: Training budgets, model sizes, preprocessing, metrics and testing procedures match throughout Sections 6 and Appendices C–D. The added computing acknowledgments do not establish any experimental setting change.

E4.justification: The self-conditioning and latent-propagation ablations, computational controls, idle-step analysis, scalability experiments, continued pre-training analysis and qualitative examples are all retained unchanged.

E5.justification: Statistical estimation and repeated-evaluation reporting are unchanged, including low-discrepancy timestep sampling and the four GPT-4.1 evaluations per sequence documented in Appendix C.

E6.justification: The main-text and appendix result tables, plotted trends and generated samples match. No numerical result entries, rankings or qualitative findings are revised.

T1.justification: The diffusion formulations, training objectives, mathematical definitions and derivations, including Equations 1–15, are unchanged. No theoretical result or proof is added.

C1.justification: The abstract, introduction and conclusion retain the same sampling-wall motivation, loopholing contribution and claims about generation quality and reasoning performance.

C2.justification: Mechanism explanations and limitations are identical, including Section 7's training and memory overhead, lack of a rigorous mathematical framework and limitations of the evaluated model scales.

D1.justification: v3 newly acknowledges access to EPFL's SCITAS cluster and the Swiss National Supercomputing Centre's Alps platform, adding limited computing-resource provenance. Hardware specifications, hyperparameters, pseudocode and code-access information otherwise remain unchanged.

R1.justification: The cited works, bibliography and positioning relative to discrete diffusion, self-conditioning and recurrent models are unchanged.

P1.justification: The acknowledgment adds Justin Deschenaux's SERI support and Swiss computing-facility credits, and the arXiv version/date stamp changes. Scientific prose and section organization remain unchanged.

P2.justification: Page 10 has reduced vertical spacing and text reflow to accommodate the expanded acknowledgment. Figures, tables, captions and appendix layouts are unchanged.

improvement.justification: v3 provides fuller funding attribution and limited computing-resource provenance, with minor page-layout adjustments. The scientific exposition, methods, complete empirical record, reproducibility instructions and limitations remain unchanged, so these additions do not materially change the paper's overall quality.
